name: Karma, too young to shut up
original_name: Karma, trop jeunes pour se taire
overview: Every day the same ritual: the students of the high school Josephine Baker pass the grids for a new day of learning... learning classes but especially life! Here we laugh, we love, we anguish, we get angry, we sing, we dance, we get agitated... And yet, here things are not so simple.
